description: Enhanced preview (step 6 in wizard) with total row count, computed totals, group headers with subtotals, orientation indicator. Enhanced PDF export with page header/footer, styled subtotals, and styled grand totals. Update project-health.json.
steps: 1. In src/app/reports/builder/page.tsx - Modify the preview panel: (a) Change runPreview to fetch ALL data (not just 20) and store in a separate state variable (fullPreviewData) for counting, while still displaying first 20 in the table. Show 'X lignes au total' where X is fullPreviewData.length. (b) After fetching, apply applyGrouping to the full data and compute totals. Display totals row at bottom of preview table (bold, bg-blue-50). (c) If groupBy is configured, render grouped preview with colored group headers (bg-indigo-50) and sub-totals per group (bg-gray-100). (d) Show an orientation indicator icon next to the preview title: a rectangle icon rotated 0deg for portrait or 90deg for landscape, using the resolved orientation value.

2. In src/app/reports/[id]/page.tsx - Enhance the PDF print styles: (a) Add a repeating header on each printed page: report title + generation date + 'Page X' (use CSS @page with running headers via @top-center, or use thead repeated approach). Since window.print is used, implement via a print-only header div that appears on every page using position: fixed/running workaround or by using table thead which naturally repeats. (b) Add a print-only footer: 'Genere par WorkDays le [date]'. (c) Style group sub-total rows with bg-gray-100 (light gray background) in both screen and print. (d) Style the grand total row (last row) with font-bold and bg-slate-200 (blue-gray). (e) Ensure all existing functionality continues working.

3. In src/app/reports/[id]/page.tsx - Add grand totals computation: After rendering all grouped data, if config.totals is defined, compute grand totals across ALL rows (not per group) and display a final summary row at the bottom with bold text and blue-gray background. This applies to both grouped and flat views.

4. Update src/data/project-health.json: (a) Add a new entry in recentChanges at the top with today's date, pr '#113', and description covering all Phase 2 features. (b) Update the 'report-builder' feature entry's notes to mention Phase 2 additions (calculated columns, advanced filters, duplicate, enhanced preview, PDF improvements, RPC aggregation).
acceptance_criteria: Preview shows 'X lignes au total' with actual full count

PDF export includes footer 'Genere par WorkDays le [date]'
Group subtotal rows have light gray background in PDF
Grand total row has bold text with blue-gray background
project-health.json is updated with Phase 2 information
TypeScript compiles without errors (next build passes)
